_provenance.notes: Sony Group corporate portal (global). Palette/type aggregated from home + computed-style walk; per-page captures via bundled crawl.mjs (lighter than full recipe — no per-section style summary).

logo.note: Iconic Sony wordmark. Source SVG ships white-fill (for dark headers); black variant derived for light headers.

palette._note: Sony brand reads near-monochrome: black wordmark, white/light-grey surfaces, restrained blue (corporate/IR) and red (alerts) accents. Faithful-modernized target keeps black primary + a single refined blue accent.

type.headingFamily: SST (Sony proprietary) → fallback Arial, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
type.bodyFamily: SST → fallback Arial, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
observedStacks: "SST W20 Roman", "SST W55 Regular", Arial, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

scaleAudit.note: Dense corporate scale (11-16px body, larger display headings). Modernized target uses a cleaner modular scale.

type.targetSubstitute: Inter (or system Helvetica/Arial stack) — SST is unlicensed; Inter is the closest free humanist-grotesque match for a faithful modernized look.

motifs.aesthetic: minimalist, editorial, generous whitespace, image-forward, restrained chrome

heroMedium.note: SIGNATURE motion — home hero is a rotating slideshow of brand stories. Prototype must reproduce the auto-rotating carousel, not a single static image. prefers-reduced-motion: hold first slide.

voice.headline: Creative Entertainment Vision
voice.tagline: Sony Group Portal — creativity and technology

header.note: Mega-menu style global nav over /en/SonyInfo/* sections.

footer.note: Large multi-column corporate footer + legal row.
